why: These are the only labels this pack has that it did not write about itself. They were authored for a DIFFERENT system, before this pack existed, by someone answering their own question — which is the entire reason they are worth grading against. Held only by reference, the external evaluation reported NOT_RUN on any checkout without the sibling installed, which is exactly the checkout where an outside opinion matters most.
rule: A copy is not the original. The sibling is preferred when present and this is the fallback; the hashes below make a divergence between the two visible instead of silent, and nothing in this pack may edit these files to make a number move.
